D0_vanilla.technique: Textbook DeepONet: branch on the 18 raw contract parameters plus a put flag, trunk on (S_1/K, ..., S_4/K, tau); price labels from the reference; Adam

D1_reduced.technique: Exact symmetry reduction: branch on (sigma_1..sigma_4, rho_12..rho_34), trunk on (z, s_1, s_2, s_3, tau); put-call parity

D2_hard_payoff.technique: Hard terminal condition: c = Levy + tau * <branch, trunk(z, s, sqrt(tau))>

D3_differential.technique: Differential (Sobolev) training: add the 25 derivative labels in (y_1..y_4, tau, sigma_1..sigma_4, rho_12..rho_34), first and second order in the log forwards

D4_physics.technique: Physics-informed DeepONet: add the PDE residual on unlabelled collocation over the whole computational domain (tau from 0) and the far-boundary condition

D5_similarity.technique: Boundary-layer coordinate in the trunk: tanh(z / (3 sigma_ref sqrt(tau))) with sigma_ref = 0.35, so the trunk still sees coordinates only

D6_lbfgs.technique: Quasi-Newton polish: full-batch L-BFGS warm-started from D5 on 4,096 labelled contracts and 4,096 collocation points

D8_envelope.technique: Enveloped correction: c = Levy + tau * phi(d_2) * <branch, trunk>, trained from a fresh start through the Adam and L-BFGS stages

D9_ensemble.technique: Ensemble: average of four independently seeded D8 trainings (seeds 0-3); Greeks are member averages

D10_permutation.technique: Stock-permutation augmentation: every labelled draw (price and derivative labels) is presented under a random relabelling of the four stocks, under which the price is unchanged; otherwise as D8, from a fresh start, one seed
